newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank board meeting held by letter, no changes.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank board meeting held by letter, no changes.

text.p: A board meeting of Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, held a written exchange of information on Thursday with no policy changes announced.
The board conducts its business by an exchange of letters rather than holding a meeting when the only point on the agenda is information about financial statistics, a Riksbank spokesman said.
Information about financial statistics is a standing point at a bank board meeting.
The Riksbank's key interest rate, the repo, currently stands at 4.10 percent while its deposit and lending rates are 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent respectively.
The Riksbank board next meets on July 31 at 0800 GMT.
